description.en: Customizable React UI primitives and theme foundations for rapid product design.
description.zh: 为加速现代产品交付打造的高度可定制 React 底层原语与主题基础设施。

content.en: Componentry is an accessible, theme-driven component library created to accelerate product design systems in React. It couples headless interaction mechanics with an expressive design token system, supporting rapid brand theming with rock-solid accessibility defaults.
content.zh: Componentry 是一套无障碍优先、设计令牌驱动的现代化 React 基础组件系统。它将无样式的底层交互逻辑与灵活的 Design Tokens 主题体系相结合，兼顾轻巧体积与强扩展能力，助力团队高效搭建统一品牌调性的前端产品。
